profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Priovant Therapeutics
profile.summary:
• Advanced proficiency in Python, Flask, Django, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, NodeJS, Javascript, React, Heroku platform, Rackspace cloud services, RESTful API design and maintenance, Cucumber integration testing
• Extensive experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) ECS, S3, SNS, SQS, DynamoDB, Lambda, API Gateway, CloudFormation and Ruby/NodeJS SDK's for AWS, Twilio video, voice and messaging API/SDK, TwiML, Mailgun API, Heroku API, Webix front-end framework
• Master's degree in IT Security
• Model-View-Controller methodologies, Javascript, HTML, deploying web applications and PostgreSQL, MS SQL / MySQL, Snowflake databases, leveraging Google APIs, Jenkins and CircleCI CI/CD
• Have worked with Scrum and Kanban methodologies, JIRA, Trello, Confluence and extremely proficient in remote work with software teams
• Experienced in Microsoft Excel and Excel VBA Macro programming
• Well versed in machine learning - pattern recognition techniques and similarity hashing of documents
• In depth understanding of networks and router/switch configuration
